Hey voat, I made an app [called Bleat](https://gitlab.com/PomTech/Bleat/raw/master/app-release.apk) in my free time. I've been using it as a pet project to experiment with the Android API, so don't expect it to be perfect.

I put off uploading it for quite a while. I wanted to put it on google play, but I ran into content policy (subs with nudity) and copyright (the app icon has the voat goat head in it) violations. Never got a response from hello@voat.co about using the icon. Both violations are kinda bs IMO especially because I don't plan to make any money off of this. So yeah, it's hosted on gitlab now. The plus side is that you can make sure im not spying on your phone ( ͡° ͜ʖ ͡°)

It runs on Android 4.2 (Jelly Bean) +

Currently, the app can only do what the current Voat api allows.

A few notes,

* Views the front page and any subverse that exists here. However this is only the first 100. Great for casually surfing voat while pooping, or something like that

* Currently can't see comments. I only just realized this part of the api was fixed so ill add this in the morning.

* pre-loads the top 200 subs in the navigation drawer. Sorry in advance that I didnt remove any of the subs like youngladies which still shows up there. To fix this just tap and hold the sub, and it's blocked!

* Saves and shares posts. Just tap the post to see options. Saved posts show up if you swipe to the left

* The subs in the nav drawer arent *really* subscribed just yet. Their posts don't pool together on the front page, but you can still visit them individually. A lot of the features like this are ready to go/take a few mins to implement on my end, but for now theyre unsupported by the voat api.

* links like youtube which (most likely) correspond to an app on your phone will just open in that app. m.youtube.com opens your Youtube app, etc. If you don't have the app it just opens like any other link.

* If you want to copy the inital link that a post took you to, just tap and hold the menu bar at the top

* To install youll need to enable unknown sources in your security settings

Bleat doesn't have 100% functionality like Boats because I really just didnt feel like chopping up and sorting through the HTML in the background. The whole purpose of having an API is to avoid that. I have a lot of other features implemented from the testing api already, It'll be great ;D
